source_visual_evidence: 原卷配合（三）③『小魚缸』圖示明顯是上方瓶頸狹窄、腹部鼓起的曲面玻璃容器，不是橫截面固定的直壁缸。
why: 直接以量尺讀取容器中累積水深作雨量時，須使用固定截面、能以水深代表降雨量的合適雨量器。原卷曲面魚缸不同高度處截面積不一致，不宜直接作為雨量器量測工具。
source_figures_corrective_redraw: P12_G03S2FINAL_COMPOSITE_P03 panel③ should depict original curved fishbowl rather than straight-sided aquarium
science_context: This correction concerns the shape in the source figure. A genuinely straight-sided aquarium could be an acceptable rain collector, but that is not the illustrated object.
evidence_sources: 113_康軒_三下_自然_期末評量卷_大墩國小.pdf#page=2
